married_divorce_rate.unit: divorces per 1000 married people of that sex (有偶人口離婚率), by occurrence date
married_divorce_rate.notes: 內政部戶政司 離婚/終止結婚對數、粗離婚率及有偶人口離婚率(按發生日期). ≤1973 excludes Kinmen and Matsu. Same-sex included from 2019.

divorces_by_marriage_duration.unit: divorce couples, by years married at divorce
divorces_by_marriage_duration.notes: 內政部戶政司 離婚/終止結婚對數按結婚期間(按發生日期). Starts 1988.

married_divorce_rate_by_age.unit: divorces per 1000 married people of that sex and age
married_divorce_rate_by_age.notes: 內政部戶政司 有偶人口離婚率按性別及5歲年齡組(按發生日期). Starts 1975; before 1991 rates are printed as whole numbers; 55+ blank in early years.

households_by_type.url: https://ws.dgbas.gov.tw/001/Upload/461/relfile/11525/232214/046-性別統計指標-家戶狀況按家庭組織型態分.csv (data.gov.tw dataset 27963)
households_by_type.notes: 主計總處 家庭收支調查 家戶狀況按家庭組織型態分. 單親 = one parent living with unmarried children of any age; 祖孫 = grandparent(s) with unmarried grandchildren, no parent. Starts 2001.

households_by_type_share.url: https://ws.dgbas.gov.tw/001/Upload/461/relfile/11525/232214/046-性別統計指標-家戶狀況按家庭組織型態分.csv (data.gov.tw dataset 27963)

low_income.unit: 低收入戶 households and persons (year end)
low_income.notes: 衛福部統計處. From 2011-07 the 社會救助法 widened the threshold, so 2011+ jumps; 2000 share was 1.0% of households.

household_debt.notes: 中央銀行 金融健全參考指標－家庭部門: household borrowing / GDP (%), debt service / disposable income (%), borrowing / disposable income (times). Starts 2002.

disability_share.unit: % of population holding a disability card (身心障礙手冊/證明)
disability_share.notes: 內政部統計通報 100年第49週, 102年第24週. 2002 = 2012 minus the 1.1 point rise the 2012 notice states. 2011 is end of September. No official series before 2001 found.
